prompt: From this report, state: (a) the largest single seizure of the substance (amount, place, year, origin), as given in the main text and, if different, as given in Annex 1; (b) the date of the report (month and year), as printed on the document.
answer:
**(a) Largest single seizure:** The main text describes "a single large-scale seizure of just over 120 kilograms of powder at the external EU border, originating in India." The seizure was in 2021, and the country of seizure is not named. Annex 1 gives the same seizure as 122 kg of powder, so the amounts agree.

The report also mentions that Dutch police seized 350 kg of chemically masked 3-MMC (N-acetyl-3-MMC) in 2019, which is larger. However, that was a masked derivative rather than 3-MMC powder, so it is not clearly the largest seizure of the substance itself.

**(b) Date:** The provided content does not show a printed publication date. The Foreword says the report was submitted to the European Commission on 25 November 2021, and the risk assessment meeting took place on 18 November 2021.
